newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rugby union-New IRFB charter to combat predictability.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-New IRFB charter to combat predictability.

text.p: Rugby union law makers have drafted a charter to combat the growing predictability of the game -- particularly in the southern hemisphere.
The technical committee of the International Rugby Football Board (IRFB) released the five-page document at the end of a four-day meeting in Cape Town on Friday.
The charter explains the principles of the game and how the laws should be interpreted by referees.
